summary: RFC 4379 defines MPLS LSP Ping and Traceroute, where the Router Alert Option must be set in the IP header of the Echo Request messages. This document explains how IPv6 Router Alert Option is used for these messages. It is now historic.

eli5.summary: Special test messages need a flag so routers look at them. This explains the flag for the newer addressing. It is historic.

questions: ipv6 router alert option mpls oam
